descriptionMarkdown:
Mark IV Multipurpose interstellar craft.

Refer to previous version for existing features. (https://www.factorio.school/view/-OXjjNRfALOOOkBFJDrZ)

New Features: 

Capable of producing legendary coal and explosives for making consumable weaponry.

Capable of processing legendary holmium plates into superconductors and capacitors.

Capable of playing "Weight of the World" from Nier;Automata (Courtesy of Miditorio)

Capable of displaying decorative lights. These can be configured using a constant combinator near the hub, or set to cycle through a rainbow using a switch near the bottom (Courtesy of UNTRA)

Includes ON/OFF switch just above main hub to disable crafting during setup.

Corrected belting issues that could cause blockages in asteroid cycler.

Lasers are now set to fire at medium asteroids until sufficient bullets have been stockpiled. Guns have been reorganized to consider this.

Cleaned and reorganized wiring for ease of use and maintenance.
title: H.S.S Glory Mk IV
